Processing_Method: Step 1: Derive 2-yr return period rainfall from DB05 frequency analysis (Gumbel or GEV distribution). Step 2: Run Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) inundation model using G09 DEM and G14 flow accumulation. Step 3: Where authoritative 1D/2D hydraulic model results (HEC-RAS) are available from NIHSA or state authorities use those as primary source and HAND as supplement. Step 4: Validate using G25 observed flood events — >=70% of frequent flood events should fall within 2-yr RP zone.
Key_QC_Rules: HAND model requires hydrologically conditioned G09 DEM (DEC04 must be applied). Validation target: 70% of G25 Low-confidence events within 2-yr RP inundation zone. Document model version and parameters. Output: inundation depth raster (metres) and binary inundation extent (0/1).

Processing_Method: Same methodology as G43 but using 10-yr return period rainfall input. Expected to cover larger area and greater depths than G43.
Key_QC_Rules: Same QC rules as G43. Validate against G25 Medium-confidence events. 10-yr RP zone must be spatially larger than 2-yr RP zone for every watershed — flag inversions.

Processing_Method: Same methodology but using 100-yr return period rainfall. For critical infrastructure planning. Where NIHSA or state official 100-yr flood lines are available use as authoritative — overlay HAND model as supplementary context layer only.
Key_QC_Rules: 100-yr RP zone must be largest spatial extent among G43–G45. Where official data contradicts HAND model for a specific location document and use official. All three RP layers must be internally consistent: depth at same location should increase G43<G44<G45.

Processing_Method: Combine G43/G44/G45 into a single flood frequency classification. Each cell classified as: Very High (in G43 zone) / High (G44 only) / Moderate (G45 only) / Low (outside all zones). Weight by observed event frequency from G25: where G25 High-confidence events exceed modelled zone assign higher class. This supersedes basic G24 flood hazard as the primary flood component of ERI v2.0.
Key_QC_Rules: G46 consistency check: no cell should be classified higher than its modelled RP zone allows unless supported by G25 evidence. Cross-check with G24 — G46 should show more nuanced spatial pattern than G24 basic index. G25 High-confidence events outside G45 zone trigger model review.
Output_Indicator: Replaces G24 basic in ERI v2.0
